skill.summary: Make your OpenClaw agent portable and persistent. Version-controls SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and all core knowledge files using git with automatic GitHub push — so...

latestVersion.changelog: AI-powered memory synthesis: each machine has its own MEMORY.md on its own branch. A nightly Claude agent reads all agents' memories, deduplicates, and writes one authoritative SHARED_MEMORY.md to main. Scales to 10+ machines with zero conflicts.
